xmldoc.short_description: Compress and decompress Zstandard data and .zst files.

param_input_item.param_description: uint8 vector, character vector or string scalar (text is compressed as UTF-8).
a uint8 vector: one or more Zstandard frames.
compression level: 1 (fast) to 22 (small), negative values for faster compression, 0 for the default (3).

'auto' or an integer from 0 to 256: number of compression threads. 'auto' (default for compress and compressfile) uses the computational threads (see maxNumCompThreads) when the data is 4 MiB or more. Writers opened with fopen use one thread unless Workers is given.
a logical: true writes the seekable Zstandard format (default: false). Only with 'w'.
largest accepted decompressed size in bytes (default: Inf).
a positive number: data whose decompressed size is more than maxratio times its compressed size raises an error (default: Inf, no limit).
a character vector: text encoding used to decode the data (default: 'UTF-8').
strings: file names. By default compressfile adds '.zst' and decompressfile removes it.
file name, http or https URL (read only), uint8 bytes to read, or [] to write in memory.
'r' (read, default), 'w' (write) or 'a' (append a new frame to a file).

param_output_item.param_description: a character vector: name of the written file.
a logical: true when this build has the zstd library.
a string: version of the zstd library, empty when it is not available.
a file identifier for fread, fgetl, fgets, fscanf, textscan, fwrite, fprintf, feof, ftell, fseek, frewind, fsize and fclose.

description.p: nelson.io.zstd compresses and decompresses data with Zstandard, in memory or between files.
Compression writes one frame with a content checksum. Decompression reads every frame of the input, checks the checksums, and stops with an error on truncated or damaged data.
decompresstext decodes the decompressed bytes as text, like nelson.io.zip.readtext for a ZIP entry.
MaxSize protects against data that expands far beyond what is expected.

MaxCompressionRatio is checked while decompressing with decompress, decompresstext and decompressfile. decompressfile also stops when the output would be larger than the free disk space of the destination. When it fails, no destination file is left.
Files are processed in blocks, so their size is not limited by memory. The destination is written to a temporary file and replaced only when the operation succeeds.
Zstandard is available when Nelson is built with the zstd library; otherwise every function except isavailable and version raises an error.
fopen opens Zstandard data as a file identifier: the usual file functions read or write it block by block. A .zst file written this way appears under its name when fclose succeeds.
tobytes finishes a writer opened with fopen([], 'w'), closes its identifier and returns the compressed bytes.

Positioning is exact. The first move backward reads the data again from its start. The decoded bytes are kept in a temporary file, so the next moves backward are fast. fscanf reads this cache directly. fsize reads the data once when its size is not stored in the frame header.
Workers compresses with several threads. The output is still a standard Zstandard frame. A bad value raises the error Nelson:io:zstd:invalidWorkers.

fopen(filename, 'a') adds a new frame at the end of an existing .zst file. The file must be empty, missing, or contain Zstandard data; otherwise the error is Nelson:io:zstd:invalidData. Reading returns the content of all frames in sequence.

fopen(filename, 'w', 'Seekable', true) writes the seekable Zstandard format: independent frames of 1 MiB, followed by a seek table stored in a skippable frame. Seekable data is read with random access: fseek decodes only the frame that holds the target, and the size is known without decoding. Usual zstd tools still read these files. Seekable cannot be used with 'a' (error Nelson:io:zstd:seekableAppend).
The source of fopen can be an http or https URL. The data is downloaded first and can only be read; a write mode raises the error Nelson:io:urlReadOnly.
tobytes on an identifier that is not an in-memory writer raises the error Nelson:io:notMemoryWriter.
